timing.definition: Active dispatch estimate equals final stage elapsed wall time minus observable intervals between the last retained pre-stop supervisor checkpoint and the next resumed dispatcher. Includes dispatch/startup/recording overhead; excludes these gap intervals. It is not summed CPU time or exact physics-step time.
limitations: The exact interruption instant is not observed; small execution after the last checkpoint cannot be resolved.
Observable gaps include review/recovery time and do not prove a precise process downtime or causal shutdown mechanism.
Calendar time includes preparation and postprocessing between stages, so it exceeds summed stage active estimates plus gap intervals.

evidence_limits: This verifies retained bookkeeping, source/input provenance, complete-result metadata and native error/boundary guards; it does not independently reanalyze full trajectories.
Pinned/unchanged settings and successful readbacks do not establish physical accuracy or numerical stability of failed conditions.
Means/contact measures are conditional on validated complete trials; failures and native-invalid data are not zeros.
All dispatched trials are accounted for, but insufficient complete wave3.5 groups do not establish physical stalling; higher-height continuation requires review under the existing protocol.
Final figure/video inspection and delivery are separate obligations.

receipt.scope: Independent read-only audit of committed RESULTS metadata, per-cell scalar observations and statistical summaries. This draft reuses the already completed audit; no new physics, trajectory reconstruction or rendering.
receipt.omission_rule: Within each cutoff × height × wave group, omit exactly one complete 0–6 s displacement farthest from its group median; ties use lowest spawn index. The common retained set is used for every scored window and all A/B/C summaries. Failed trials are excluded without zero substitution. Raw stopping decisions do not omit any complete trial.
receipt.statistical_validation_method: The earlier independent audit reconstructed each median/omission from existing per-cell scalar values; recomputed every reported displacement and contact-loss mean and sample SD with statistics.mean/stdev; compared each summary values/spawn list to the common retained cell set; verified 30 planned unique spawns per group, count partitions, raw stop decisions, report links and analysis-source snapshots. No raw trajectory/contact NPZ was loaded for this independent audit.

contact_metrics.expected: Corresponding existing flat wave contact at the same CPG clock; force > 1e-8 N for each of 38 individual feet.
contact_metrics.missing: Expected flat support AND absent rough support.
contact_metrics.A: Equal mean over valid 10 ms snapshots of missing feet / expected flat feet; snapshots with zero expected feet are skipped.
contact_metrics.B: Within each nominal 1 s CPG cycle pool missing and expected foot-time samples, then take equal mean over cycle fractions.
contact_metrics.C: Pool missing and expected foot-time samples over the entire chosen window, then divide totals.

receipt.study_disposition: All authorized attempts completed through height ×2.25. All three cutoffs are insufficient_complete at ×2.25; none may be claimed to have reached the physical-stall criterion, and the original protocol pauses further heights for discussion.

key_paired_evidence.precision: Mean/SD rounded to 0.001 mm from the independent read-only calculation

descriptive_trends: At 4 mm height ×2 the completed raw paired observations support a mean wave3.5 advantage over wave2.5, whereas wave3 still trails wave2.5.

The enlarged 30-spawn comparison does not show a uniform low-wave performance recovery with restored shortwaves. Earlier demo recovery remains a specific observation, not a demonstrated general mechanism.
At height ×1, wave2 retained group means for 2/4/8 mm are 122.88/123.61/135.21 mm; the raw paired 2-minus-8 mm difference is negative.
At height ×1.75, wave2 retained group means suggest about +14.3 mm for 2 versus 8 mm, but the 15 common raw complete pairs give −0.70 ±19.03 mm; changing completed sets can create apparent recovery.
limitations: Mean/SD are conditional on completed native-error-free, finite, boundary-safe trials; missing outcomes are not represented as zero. At higher heights the incomplete fraction is large.
The smallest retained group has n=7. Sample SD (ddof=1) describes variation among shared spatial/heading observations; it is not a confidence interval.
The 30 spawns are positions/headings on one fixed Libo mother surface, not 30 independent terrain realizations; spawning varies position and heading together.
One existing flat control per wave provides no repeat-based flat variance estimate.
The user-selected single-point omission may remove genuine stuck or reverse physical outcomes. Raw paired comparisons and raw stop decisions are reported separately.
A/B/C describe phase-aligned contact-pattern differences; phase shifts contribute. They are not calibrated IID contact-erasure probabilities or proof of anchoring.
Loss-axis intersections need not compare equal physical terrain conditions across waves.
Matched phase/grid and height multipliers do not make cutoff comparisons exactly equal in RMS roughness; source triangle subdivision can change finite-precision mesh cooking.
No universal gait superiority, broad monotonic shortwave benefit or causal anchor-point mechanism follows from these descriptive observations.
Independent audit checks existing JSON evidence and source snapshots; it does not independently reload/revalidate bulk native trajectories or replace image/video QA.
